rule: a training row is flagged for a gated problem (held-out or dev) when it names that problem's own formalisation (lineage), or holds a t program, in its answer or its prompt, that passes at least one of the problem's test points, fails none, and on 100 drawn inputs answers fewer than 10% of the inputs both answer differently from the problem's reference (twin; t/twin_draws.py), the problem's length argument left out where it has one
